text:
oncall-bot: PAGER: [sev2] service=inference-continuous-batcher region=us-west2 p99=2300ms (> SLO 500ms). Streaming stalls observed, multiple hosts reporting long tail. Pager -> @sam

sam: I'm on it, grabbing dashboards. Any immediate customer reports?

ops-bot: Alert details: https://grafana.company/r/dash/contbatch?panel=tail_latencies  runbook: /runbooks/contbatch-tail.md :rotating_light:

anya: seeing large spikes in packer_wait_ms and pack_size variance. Timeline aligns with KV eviction spikes at 12:40:01 UTC. Pack filler is combining short+long seqs -> long request holds batch, streaming responses blocked.

kevin: runtime logs show repeated "evicting-kv" + scheduler preemption lag. Also noticed streaming queue weight dropped (was 0.6 -> 0.2) after yesterday's deploy. That plus mixed-seqlen packing explains the tail.

sam: ok immediate mitigations I can push now:
```
# 1) reduce pack_timeout for streaming route
curl -X POST $ADMIN_API/routes/streaming/config -d '{"pack_timeout_ms":20}'
# 2) lower max_batch for streaming to 64
curl -X POST $ADMIN_API/routes/streaming/config -d '{"max_batch_tokens":64}'
# 3) bump streaming queue weight to 0.9
curl -X POST $ADMIN_API/scheduler/weights -d '{"streaming":0.9}'
```
I'll apply 1 & 3 first, then 2 if we still see p99.

elaine: CS reports 12 streaming failures from customer "acme-app" in the last 10m, latency/timeouts. They're asking for ETA.

sam: message to ACME: "We've identified a transient tail latency issue affecting streaming sessions in us-west2. We're mitigating now (changing batching config). Expect improvements within 5-10m. We'll follow up with details and a postmortem."

anya: quick note: for emergency we can enable per-request hedging for streaming route (2x) but that increases token cost. Prefer scheduler + pack_timeout first.

kevin: applied scheduler weight bump on host pool 3 and reduced pack_timeout to 25ms on canary hosts. Observing p99 drop from 2300ms -> ~700ms on canary within 90s. Promoting change to all hosts now.

sam: promoting config to all us-west2 hosts. Rolling now, will watch SLOs.

ops-bot: Deploy note: config-rollback safepoint created (cfg-1749).

anya: after full roll we're at p99 ~480ms, p95 ~120ms. Streaming stalls cleared on most hosts. Remaining outliers tied to a handful of long-seq model requests that still pack into larger batches.

sam: next immediate step: set max_batch_tokens=64 for streaming route to avoid long-seq packing. I'll schedule a short canary 2m window.

kevin: noted. Also adding quick guard: reject pack if contains request with seq_len > 1500 or if mixedness > 0.7. Patching packer heuristic now (hotfix).

sam: hotfix applied on canary, verifying.

elaine: Customer reply: "Thanks — latency improved, one reconnect left. Please advise when fixed fully."

sam: good. Marking incident as mitigated for customer impact. We'll keep the incident open for RCA.

anya: action items:
- postmortem with timeline (owner: anya)
- revert scheduler weight change if root cause addressed (owner: kevin)
- add metric: packer_wait_ms p99 and percent of mixed-seqlen batches (owner: runtime team)
- consider default max_batch downgrade for streaming routes (product discussion)

kevin: I'll follow up with a PR to tighten packer heuristics and add a flag to opt-in to conservative packing for streaming.

sam: thanks all. I'll update ACME once postmortem is drafted. Closing pager, switching to oncall follow-up. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> customer impact reduced. Keeping incident open for RCA.
